ModMetaData.name: Name to Namaé
ModMetaData.author: Cljur
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces RimWorld's built-in English pawn and animal names when they are generated. The included Japanese name pack contains kana readings for 27,914 pawn names and 1,962 animal names. Separate name-pack mods can add other languages.
Pawn first names, last names, and nicknames are replaced on generation. Colony animals can receive proper names when they are born, hatched, tamed, self-tamed, or join the colony. Player-entered names and existing proper names are left alone.
Names already stored in a save are not changed unless you use the one-way conversion in the mod settings. Back up the save before converting them.
Also includes Japanese text for developer-mode actions, name reports, and optional experimental line breaking. Requires Harmony.
